You don't need more willpower

You need a protocol your body can actually follow

Myth vs Fact

More cardio is the fastest route to fat loss.
MYTH
FACT
Recovery drives adaptation. Sleep and rest are when your body actually changes.
In our cohort, members who prioritized sleep lost 2.3x more body fat than the cardio-only group.

CORE DEFINITION

Cortisol

/ˈkɔːrtɪsɒl/

The stress hormone that, chronically elevated, blocks fat loss and disrupts sleep.

Spiking it with dawn cardio while sleep-deprived is the fastest way to stall progress.

CORE DEFINITION

Zone 2

/zoʊn tuː/

Easy-effort cardio (conversation pace) that builds aerobic base without frying recovery.

80% of your cardio volume should live here.
